mapper.select: SELECT id AS noteId, title, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM note WHERE folder_id = #{folderId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT n.id AS noteId, u.account AS authorAccount, f.id AS folderId, f.name AS folderName, n.title, n.markdown_content AS markdownContent, n.rendered_html AS renderedHtml, n.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM note n INNER JOIN user_account u ON u.id = n.author_user_id INNER JOIN folder f ON f.id = n.folder_id WHERE n.id = #{noteId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO note (author_user_id, folder_id, title, markdown_content, rendered_html, publication_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{authorUserId}, #{folderId}, #{title}, #{markdownContent}, #{renderedHtml}, #{publicationStatus}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE note SET folder_id = #{folderId}, title = #{title}, markdown_content = #{markdownContent}, rendered_html = #{renderedHtml}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
